description: Open a checkout for online access to a book (or the whole library) for a reader, tied to their email. Returns a payment link to give to the reader; nothing is charged until they pay. After paying, the reader signs in on the site with that email and the book is theirs.

currency.description: USD, RUB or BRL. Default: by language.

item.description: A book slug from list_books, or "library".

locale.description: Language: en, ru, pt or es.

name: create_checkout
title: Open a checkout
